title: Age-dependent cholesterol association does not establish incremental cross-site CAD prediction: an exploratory public angiography analysis
abstract: Adding an age-by-cholesterol interaction changed Hungarian Brier loss from 0.146934 to 0.151621 (difference +0.004687; source-refit/target bootstrap95% interval [-0.005724, +0.019826]). Incremental improvement was not established. Models were trained only in Cleveland, but both cohorts were previously used by the author: this is exploratory site transfer, not untouched confirmation. A negative result does not establish equivalence or refute age-related lipid biology.
